intro: The **Payment Services initializer** configures payment processing features including payment methods, payment providers, and transaction handling. Use initialization to integrate payment gateways and customize payment data models.

apiUrl.description: URL for the payment or Commerce API endpoint. Required for payment processing and backend communication.

getCustomerToken.description: Function that returns the current customer auth token, or null if not authenticated. Used for authenticated API requests.

storeViewCode.description: Store view code for the Commerce backend. Determines locale, currency, and catalog scope for API requests.
